title: feat(cli): add polli harness with Pi profile
author: davealan74
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Adds `polli harness pi on|off|status` to connect [Pi](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi) to Pollinations
- Configures Pi via `~/.pi/agent/models.json` (custom provider), `auth.json` (dedicated child key), and `settings.json` (default model + provider)
- Installs the packaged `polli` skill to `~/.pi/agent/skills/polli/SKILL.md`, which Pi auto-discovers at startup
- Offers install instructions when `pi` is not found in PATH
- Snapshots files before changes and restores byte-for-byte (or surgically strips) on `off`
- 14 new tests covering all acceptance criteria; all existing tests still pass
- Updates `CODING_HARNESSES.md` and `packages/polli-cli/SKILL.md`

## Test plan

- [ ] `polli harness pi on` — configures Pi with Pollinations provider and default model
- [ ] `polli harness pi on --model kimi` — selects alternate model
- [ ] `polli harness pi status` — reports configured state and active model
- [ ] `polli harness pi off` — restores original files byte-for-byte
- [ ] `polli harness pi off` (after user edits) — strips only Pollinations entries, preserves user changes
- [ ] `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` env override, tilde expansion
- [ ] Existing skill file not overwritten
- [ ] `npx vitest run packages/polli-cli/src/harnesses/pi.test.ts` — all 14 tests pass

Fixes #14119

gist.headline: Pi joins the garden
gist.blurb: The polli CLI can now teach Pi where the good models grow. One command wires up a dedicated key, provider settings, and a freshly packed skill—then tidies up after itself when asked.
gist.summary: Added `polli harness pi on|off|status`, which configures Pi through its `models.json`, `auth.json`, and `settings.json`, installs the Pollinations skill, supports alternate models such as `--model kimi`, and safely restores or selectively removes the integration on teardown.
gist.impact: Pi users can connect a Pollinations provider and default model with one CLI command, inspect the active setup with `status`, and later remove it without overwriting their own configuration edits.

Polli should be actively installing the connection with a tiny tool belt, and the monitor robot can eagerly display a simple "PI READY" status, emphasizing one-command setup and careful, reversible configuration.
